name: Procedure Exchange
description: Share step-by-step procedures, try them and report what worked.
features: Twelve original, complete editorial methods with concrete inputs, actions, done checks and expected artifacts
Independent local authoring, immutable run snapshots, private execution records and explicit completed, partial or blocked declarations
Strict private project JSON, reusable attributed method packages, standalone HTML reports and actual artifact text downloads
Real public search, immutable published revisions, pinned forks and step-ID comparisons
Explicit account-reported outcomes per published revision, owner revision checks, withdrawal and reporting
Optional owner-only private vault copies under a separate label, with public text isolated from private run data
businessHypothesis: Useful methods can bring repeat visits when people perform the work again, improve a source-pinned fork and share the resulting instructions or report. The local workflow and public reuse remain accessible; optional membership adds private saved-project capacity. This first workspace delivery has no third-party advertising scripts.
